sentences.en: Period.

sentences.zh: 如果地球的平均气温上升超过这个幅度，后果可能是灾难性的。

sentences.en: Global temperature is likely to reach 1.5 degrees C between 2030 to 2052.
sentences.zh: 全球气温很可能在2030年至2052年间达到1.5摄氏度。

sentences.en: 600 people are still unaccounted for, and at least 66 people have been killed due to wildfires in California.
sentences.zh: 加州野火已造成至少66人死亡，仍有600人下落不明。

sentences.en: Hey, guess what?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: We're not going to catch on fire, okay?
sentences.zh: 我们不会被烧着的，好吗？

sentences.en: We're doing all right.
sentences.zh: 我们做得还不错。

sentences.en: The Butte County Sheriff now says 85 people are confirmed dead.
sentences.zh: 比尤特县警长现已确认有85人死亡。

sentences.en: This makes the campfire now the deadliest wildfire in California history.
sentences.zh: 这使得“营火”成为加州历史上最致命的野火。

sentences.en: Well, Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg is having to explain his way out of controversy yet again.
sentences.zh: 脸书首席执行官马克·扎克伯格又不得不为争议进行辩解。

sentences.en: Holocaust deniers, he said, would not be blocked from Facebook.
sentences.zh: 他说，不会封禁脸书上的大屠杀否认者。

sentences.en: Facebook is receiving criticism again today for how it handled evidence of Russian election interference on the social network.
sentences.zh: 脸书今天再次因其处理社交网络上俄罗斯干预选举证据的方式而受到批评。

sentences.en: The mystery deepens tonight over the fate of Jamal Khashoggi.
sentences.zh: 今晚，贾迈勒·卡舒吉的命运愈发扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Jamal Khashoggi, a respected Saudi Arabian journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 贾迈勒·卡舒吉，一位受人尊敬的沙特阿拉伯记者。

sentences.en: Khashoggi's body was dismembered, chopped up into small pieces.
sentences.zh: 卡舒吉的遗体被肢解，切成了碎块。

sentences.en: The CIA has concluded now that the Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman personally ordered the murder.
sentences.zh: 中央情报局现已断定，沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼亲自下令实施了谋杀。

sentences.en: That he told me that he had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我他与此事毫无关系。

sentences.en: There are new calls to end U.S.
sentences.zh: 目前有新的呼声要求美国结束

sentences.en: involvement in the war in Yemen as the fallout continues over Khashoggi's murder.
sentences.zh: 对也门战争的介入，因为卡舒吉遇害案的余波仍在持续。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, uncertainty over the U.S.-China trade deal is casting a shadow over an economy.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，美中贸易协议的不确定性正给经济蒙上阴影。

sentences.en: Do you think there will be any kind of an agreement in the year ahead?
sentences.zh: 你认为未来一年会达成某种协议吗？

sentences.en: I think the president is doing the right thing and standing up to China economically.
sentences.zh: 我认为总统做得对，在经济上对抗中国。

sentences.en: The midterm election is less than two weeks away.
sentences.zh: 距离中期选举不到两周了。

sentences.en: And the question now is, will there be a blue wave or just a ripple?
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是，会掀起蓝色浪潮，还是仅仅泛起涟漪？

sentences.en: This is one of the most important elections of our entire lives.
sentences.zh: 这是我们一生中最重要的选举之一。

sentences.en: With just 20 days until the midterm elections, voter suppression is a real issue.
sentences.zh: 距离中期选举仅剩20天，选民压制是一个现实问题。

sentences.en: We're talking about immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论移民问题。

sentences.en: We're talking about health care.
sentences.zh: 我们在谈论医疗保健问题。

sentences.en: We're talking about health care shaping up to be a key issue in the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 我们正在谈论医疗保健如何成为中期选举的关键议题。

sentences.en: The fight over Brett Kavanaugh, as we've been reporting, has sparked partisan fury.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所报道的，围绕布雷特·卡瓦诺的争斗引发了党派愤怒。

sentences.en: But gun control is not at the top of the list, as many said it would be.
sentences.zh: 但枪支管制并没有像许多人预期的那样排在首位。

sentences.en: Democrats and Republicans running full speed ahead.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和共和党人都在全速前进。

sentences.en: President Trump is about to get very, very busy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统即将变得非常、非常忙碌。

sentences.en: He has an eight-state campaign blitz.
sentences.zh: 他有八个州的竞选闪电战。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, the voters of this state will cast their ballots in one of the most important
sentences.zh: 明天，这个州的选民将投下他们的一票，这是你们一生中、我们所有人一生中

sentences.en: Senate elections of your lives, of all of our lives.
sentences.zh: 最重要的参议院选举之一。

sentences.en: You made it.
sentences.zh: 你做到了。

sentences.en: It's finally here.
sentences.zh: 它终于来了。

sentences.en: I'll decision in 2018.
sentences.zh: 我将在2018年做出决定。

sentences.en: It is another election day in America.
sentences.zh: 这是美国的又一个选举日。

sentences.en: We do have our first flip of the night from red to blue.
sentences.zh: 我们确实迎来了今晚第一个从红色翻转为蓝色的选区。

sentences.en: CNN can now project that Democrats will win the majority in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）现预测民主党将赢得美国

sentences.en: House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 众议院的多数席位。

sentences.en: You will hear my voice.
sentences.zh: 你会听到我的声音。

sentences.en: This is a huge win for the Democrats, a huge setback for the president and for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这对民主党来说是一场巨大的胜利，对总统和共和党人来说是一次巨大的挫折。

sentences.en: We don't only welcome immigrants, we send them to Washington.
sentences.zh: 我们不仅欢迎移民，还把他们送到华盛顿。

sentences.en: We voted and we won and we did all of this together.
sentences.zh: 我们投票了，我们赢了，我们一起完成了这一切。

sentences.en: More than 100 women will serve on Capitol Hill in the next term, first time ever.
sentences.zh: 下一届国会中，将有超过100名女性在国会山任职，这是史无前例的。

sentences.en: More than two dozen of them for the first time.
sentences.zh: 其中超过二十多位是首次当选。

sentences.en: But the GOP added to its narrow majority in the Senate after the president's last-minute campaign blitz.
sentences.zh: 但在总统最后一刻的竞选闪电战后，共和党扩大了其在参议院的微弱多数优势。

sentences.en: God bless Texas!
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑德克萨斯！

sentences.en: The new Congress will be divided with Democrats leading the House and Republicans in charge of the Senate.
sentences.zh: 新一届国会将出现分裂，民主党领导众议院，共和党掌控参议院。

sentences.en: A divided Congress for a divided nation.
sentences.zh: 一个分裂的国会，面对一个分裂的国家。

sentences.en: And this is going to be a big problem for President Trump going forward.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普总统未来的工作来说将是一个大问题。

sentences.en: If he thinks that the media is annoying, wait till he meets a Democratic House that has subpoena
sentences.zh: 如果他觉得媒体很烦人，等他遇到拥有传唤权的民主党众议院时就知道了，

sentences.en: power and actually has the legal ability to force them to turn over documents, we're going to look like nothing compared to that.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上有法律能力强制他们交出文件，我们（媒体）与之相比简直不值一提。

sentences.en: For Democrats, these are the spoils of victory.
sentences.zh: 对于民主党人来说，这些是胜利的战利品。

sentences.en: They can now launch investigations, issue subpoenas, even demand tax returns.
sentences.zh: 他们现在可以发起调查、发出传票，甚至要求查看纳税申报表。

sentences.en: Democrat Nita Lowy, set to chair the powerful Appropriations Committee, checked off a laundry list of potential areas for inquiry.
sentences.zh: 即将担任强大的拨款委员会主席的民主党人尼塔·洛伊，列出了一长串潜在的调查领域。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The travel ban.
sentences.zh: 旅行禁令。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The family separation policy.
sentences.zh: 家庭分离政策。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Hurricane relief in Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各的飓风救灾。

sentences.en: Oh, it was absolutely inadequate.
sentences.zh: 哦，那绝对是不够的。

sentences.en: You have all those critical chairmanships, House oversight, House intelligence.
sentences.zh: 你们拥有所有那些关键的主席职位，众议院监督委员会、众议院情报委员会。

sentences.en: Look at the rebirth of many lines of the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 看看俄罗斯调查中许多线索的重生。

sentences.en: I could see democratically controlled House of Representatives voting for impeachment.
sentences.zh: 我能预见由民主党控制的众议院会投票弹劾。

sentences.en: If we don't get what we want, one way or the other, whether it's through you, through a military, through anything you want to call, I will shut down the government.
sentences.zh: 如果我们得不到我们想要的，无论通过什么方式，无论是通过你、通过军队，还是任何你想称呼的东西，我都会让政府停摆。

sentences.en: Okay, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好吧，很有道理。

sentences.en: And I am proud.
sentences.zh: 我感到自豪。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you what.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你吧。

sentences.en: If you watch Tuesday's spectacle in the Oval Office, you got a preview of what to expect in 2019 when Democrats take over the House.
sentences.zh: 如果你看了周二在椭圆形办公室的那场闹剧，你就提前看到了2019年民主党接管众议院后会发生什么。

sentences.en: So the scene is already set for some fiery months ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以，未来几个月激烈的局面已经定型了。

sentences.en: Will Mueller move to indict anyone in the president's immediate circle?
sentences.zh: 穆勒会采取行动起诉总统核心圈子里的任何人吗？

sentences.en: Will anyone at Facebook be held accountable for anything?
sentences.zh: 脸书会有人为任何事情负责吗？

sentences.en: Will President Trump and the House Democrats end up in an impeachment fight by the end of the year?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统和众议院民主党人会在年底前陷入弹劾之争吗？

sentences.en: Will a dispute arising out of the Mueller investigation reach the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 穆勒调查引发的争议会闹到最高法院吗？

sentences.en: And what will it do?
sentences.zh: 那会产生什么影响？

sentences.en: How much of an issue will climate change be in the 2020 presidential campaign?
sentences.zh: 气候变化在2020年总统竞选中会成为多大的议题？

sentences.en: How will Nancy Pelosi hold House Democrats together?
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西将如何团结众议院民主党人？

sentences.en: Will the year of the woman in 2018 help Democrats get over their fears about nominating a woman as their presidential candidate?
sentences.zh: 2018年的“女性之年”会帮助民主党人克服提名女性作为总统候选人的恐惧吗？

sentences.en: Will the Trump administration ramp up its tightening policies and practices around immigration?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府会加大在移民问题上的收紧政策和做法吗？

sentences.en: Where will the major terror attacks of 2019 happen?
sentences.zh: 2019年重大的恐怖袭击会发生在什么地方？

sentences.en: Will the North Koreans conclude they're never really going to get sanctions lifted and go back to launching missiles and testing nukes?
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人会得出他们永远无法真正解除制裁的结论，从而重新开始发射导弹和进行核试验吗？

sentences.en: Will another country step up to take in immigrants who are turned away from the United States?
sentences.zh: 会有另一个国家站出来接收被美国拒之门外的移民吗？

sentences.en: What is Russia doing to get ready for the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯正在为2020年选举做些什么准备？

sentences.en: Will Democrats get President Trump's tax returns?
sentences.zh: 民主党人能拿到特朗普总统的纳税申报表吗？

sentences.en: And what will they show?
sentences.zh: 它们会显示什么？

sentences.en: How will President Trump's environmental rollbacks roll back the country's policy?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的环境政策倒退将如何削弱国家的政策？

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: For the next week, we're going to revisit our favorite episodes of the year, listen back, and then hear what's happened since the stories first ran.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一周里，我们将重温今年我们最喜欢的剧集，回顾一下，并听听这些故事首次播出后发生了什么。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
